title: Online Election
description: Find the leader of an election at a given time using binary search on precomputed winner snapshots.
pseudocode:
1. map = {}, maxVotes = 0, currentLeader = -1
2. winners = []
3. for i in range(len(persons)):
4.   map[persons[i]]++
5.   if map[persons[i]] >= maxVotes:
6.     maxVotes = map[persons[i]], currentLeader = persons[i]
7.   winners.push(currentLeader)
8. idx = binarySearch(times, target)
9. return winners[idx]
